tasks.short: Coordinate freight and passenger service personnel

steps.what: Read the current train duty, crew assignments and passenger or freight service requirements
inputs: existing train duty, crew roster and service plan

steps.what: Confirm actual crew availability and readiness for the train's services
inputs: understood train and service assignments
crew's actual availability and readiness
outputs: confirmed actual crew readiness and gaps

steps.what: Supervise and coordinate crew transport, boarding, porter, accommodation or meal service activities
inputs: confirmed actual crew readiness and gaps
actual freight/passenger service conditions
outputs: coordinated actual crew activity and observed service issues

steps.what: Resolve actual crew or passenger service exceptions and decide follow-up actions
inputs: coordinated actual crew activity and observed service issues
crew and passenger questions
outputs: resolved exceptions and actual follow-up decisions

steps.what: Write actual crew coordination, service exceptions and follow-up decisions in the duty note
inputs: confirmed actual crew readiness and gaps
observed service issues and actual follow-up decisions

steps.what: Read and approve the completed duty note against actual crew and service events
inputs: complete actual duty note
actual follow-up decisions and observed service issues

steps.what: Save the approved duty note in the same operations system
inputs: approved final duty note

tasks.design: Retain crew supervision and service coordination using {TELEPHONY} and {OTHER}, the train or yard. Try native verbatim dictation into the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} duty note; the conductor checks the actual account before its separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: A roster does not establish actual readiness or service exceptions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native dictation may reduce typing of a conductor's actual account without summarising or choosing actions.
tasks.still_hard: Coordinate live crew activity and resolve passenger or freight exceptions.
tasks.human_edge: Respond to actual conditions and crew communication.

ambition.what: Reduce supported note entry while retaining live supervision.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; verify approved device use, staff-data access and consultation requirements

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native dictation can transcribe a worker's actual account into an editable duty note.

assumptions: Scenario covers applicable service activities across train types, not all listed services on every duty. Existing operations owner supplies duty/train ID, roster and service plan; s1 reads them. s2 obtains actual readiness and s3/s4 produce actual service findings and decisions. Crew members' execution time remains unchanged outside focal labour.

s5 includes conductor dictation of actual train/duty, event time, issue, action and unresolved follow-up, plus correction of the transcript; retained 70% includes that capture. No new crew status feed or free structured observation producer is assumed. Speech recognition is configured for verbatim entry, not a semantic summary loop.

Native duty forms and approved dictation come first. Central is conditional on typing-heavy note work still occurring today. Live readiness checks, coordination and exception handling remain full time. If current direct entry is quicker or dictation is unavailable, no change is made and saving is zero.

s6 follows the completed note; edits void approval. Same-system save is approximately zero time and earns no saving. No dispatch, crew reassignment or passenger message is machine-sent. Provisional B=100, R=96.4, gross=3.6; incremental focal dictation/error upkeep=1; net=2.6. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Actual duty-note typing burden and dictation accuracy in the work setting.
research_questions: Compare note entry with approved dictation including all corrections and final reading, outside live operating attention.

already_counted.description: Final duty-note verification retained at s6

incremental.description: Inspect dictation errors and maintain approved vocabulary/settings

approvals.approved_version: complete final actual crew/service duty note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where direct entry is quicker or dictation unavailable; high allows one extra hour correcting service terminology beyond central net 2.6.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise train mechanical inspection and maintenance

steps.what: Read required mechanical inspections, open defects and assigned maintenance work
inputs: existing inspection requirements, actual defect records and maintenance assignments

steps.what: Observe workers' actual inspection and maintenance of train mechanical equipment
inputs: understood inspection and maintenance scope
actual workers, equipment and work conditions
outputs: actual supervision findings and observed deficiencies

steps.what: Direct workers and clarify inspection or maintenance deficiencies
inputs: actual supervision findings and observed deficiencies
workers' actual questions and response
outputs: understood corrective directions and actual work response

steps.what: Verify actual completion and identify unresolved equipment defects
inputs: understood corrective directions and actual work response
actual completed work and equipment condition
outputs: verified supervision outcome and unresolved defects

steps.what: Record actual inspection supervision, completed work and unresolved defects
inputs: verified supervision outcome and unresolved defects
existing train/equipment identifiers

steps.what: Read and approve the complete supervision note against actual equipment findings
inputs: complete actual supervision note
verified supervision outcome and unresolved defects

steps.what: Save the approved supervision note in the same maintenance record system
inputs: approved final supervision note

tasks.design: Keep physical supervision and completion checks at {OTHER}, the train mechanical work area. Try native verbatim dictation in the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} supervision form, followed by full final-note verification and a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: An assigned work order does not establish actual completion or equipment condition.
tasks.enabler_now: Native dictation may reduce typed supervision text while preserving actual observation capture.
tasks.still_hard: Verify workmanship and unresolved mechanical defects.
tasks.human_edge: Notice unsafe or incomplete work and direct the workers appropriately.

ambition.what: Support the supervision record without changing inspection or release authority.

build_days.testing_rollout: 2-4; check equipment terminology and correction time
build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; verify approved devices, record access and consultation needs

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native dictation can transcribe actual equipment-work observations into an editable supervision record.

assumptions: Existing maintenance owner supplies equipment/work-order ID and required inspections; workers perform actual work and the focal supervisor observes and verifies it. Worker labour is unchanged outside focal savings. OTHER means the physical equipment/work area.

s5 counts dictation of actual equipment ID, observed work, completion finding, defect and unresolved action plus transcript corrections; retained 70% includes all capture. No planned completion or work-order status substitutes for actual verification. Native forms and approved verbatim dictation come first; no model generates a safety conclusion.

Central is conditional on typing-heavy supervision notes still occurring today. All physical observation, direction and verification remain unchanged. If native direct entry is already quicker or approved dictation unavailable, no change is made. Existing maintenance-system runtime earns no saving.

s6 follows the finished note; edits void approval. Same-system save is approximately zero time and earns no saving. No equipment release, dispatch or defect escalation message is automated. Provisional B=100, R=97.3, gross=2.7; incremental focal terminology/error upkeep=1; net=1.7. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Actual typed-note burden and equipment-term dictation accuracy.
research_questions: Compare full supervision-note entry and review without shortening physical supervision or completion verification.

already_counted.description: Final supervision-note verification retained at s6

incremental.description: Inspect equipment terminology errors and maintain approved dictation settings

approvals.approved_version: complete final actual mechanical-work supervision note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where direct entry is quicker or dictation unavailable; high allows one extra hour correcting equipment terms beyond central net 1.7.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Instruct workers to place emergency warning signals

steps.what: Assess the actual emergency stop location, train situation and immediate conditions
inputs: actual emergency stop and train location
current operating instructions

steps.what: Determine required front and rear warning-signal instructions and responsible workers
inputs: understood emergency stop conditions
current operating instructions and actual crew positions
outputs: specific warning-signal directions and designated workers

steps.what: Confirm the exact warning-signal directions and crew recipients before transmission
inputs: specific warning-signal directions and designated workers
outputs: confirmed final warning-signal directions and recipients

steps.what: Transmit the confirmed instructions to workers to set front and rear warning signals
inputs: confirmed final warning-signal directions and recipients

steps.what: Hear workers' actual read-backs and confirmation and resolve unclear responses
inputs: transmitted warning-signal instructions
workers' actual read-backs and status reports
outputs: actual acknowledged directions and unresolved status

steps.what: Record and confirm actual stop, instructions, times and crew acknowledgements
inputs: understood emergency stop conditions
transmitted warning-signal instructions
actual acknowledged directions and unresolved status

steps.what: Save the confirmed emergency-instruction note in the same operations record
inputs: confirmed final emergency-instruction note

tasks.design: Retain live warning instructions and read-backs through {TELEPHONY} with the conductor or yardmaster. Use the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} event-note fields for actual times and acknowledgements after the immediate operating work.
tasks.previous_blocker: A message being sent does not establish that a worker understood or completed a warning action.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing radio and event forms support the work but establish no additional time reduction.
tasks.still_hard: Communicate correct directions under actual emergency-stop conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Judge the situation and resolve ambiguous crew responses immediately.

ambition.what: Retain direct emergency instruction and acknowledgement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: emergency crew instructions require live confirmation and actual acknowledgements rather than reliance on a sent flag.

assumptions: OTHER is the actual train/track setting. The conductor or yardmaster observes stop conditions and uses current operating instructions; this design supplies no new operational signal-placement rules. The focal work is issuing and checking instructions; workers' physical placement labour is unchanged and outside focal savings.

s3 is immediate confirmation of the final intended instruction and crew recipient, not an added delayed approval workflow. s4 is its separate internal transmission. s5 obtains actual read-backs; no planned crew status or automatic acknowledgement substitutes for them.

s6 explicitly captures actual train/location, event times, instruction, recipient, acknowledgement and unresolved status. Native event forms and dictation are considered; no distinct repetitive typing or transcription burden beyond the existing short fields is established, so no note saving is claimed. No machine radio instruction is introduced.

s6 confirms the completed note before s7; edits invalidate approval. Same-system save is approximately zero time and carries no saving. Provisional B=100, R=100, gross=0; incremental=0; net=0. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Actual event-note burden separate from immediate emergency communication.
research_questions: Review completed event workflows and distinguish actual record capture from live instructions and read-backs.

incremental.description: No new workflow or upkeep introduced

approvals.approved_version: exact final warning directions and designated internal crew recipients

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No supported reduction after separately examining instruction decisions, transmission, read-backs, actual notes and save.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Verify timekeeping accuracy with locomotive engineers

steps.what: Read the current departure requirement and authorised reference time
inputs: existing current departure schedule
existing authorised reference clock
outputs: current departure requirement and observed reference time

steps.what: Check actual timekeeping instrument readings against the reference time
inputs: current departure requirement and observed reference time
actual timekeeping instrument displays
outputs: actual compared readings and observed discrepancy

steps.what: Verify timekeeping accuracy with the locomotive engineer and resolve discrepancies relevant to departure
inputs: actual compared readings and observed discrepancy
engineer's actual instrument reading and response
outputs: jointly checked timekeeping outcome and unresolved discrepancy

steps.what: Record and confirm actual timekeeping readings, engineer confirmation and unresolved discrepancy
inputs: jointly checked timekeeping outcome and unresolved discrepancy
actual compared readings and observed reference time

steps.what: Save the confirmed timekeeping-check record in the same operations system
inputs: confirmed final timekeeping-check record

tasks.design: Retain actual instrument checks at {OTHER}, the reference and onboard timekeeping instruments, and engineer confirmation through {TELEPHONY}. Use existing {OPS_SYSTEM} check fields for actual readings and discrepancies; no new clock-control automation is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A scheduled departure or automatic clock synchronisation does not prove the actual display being checked is correct.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing reference time and native records support verification but establish no additional saving.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise an actual discrepancy and coordinate its handling with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: Verify real instruments and the engineer's actual confirmation.

ambition.what: Retain existing timekeeping verification and departure coordination.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: checking timekeeping accuracy distinguishes actual instrument readings from schedules and automatic clock runtime.

assumptions: Existing timetable owner supplies the current departure requirement; authorised reference clock supplies actual reference time. The conductor reads actual instruments in s2 and obtains the engineer's actual confirmation in s3. The engineer's independent labour remains unchanged outside focal savings.

s4 explicitly captures actual instrument ID, check time, observed reading/reference, discrepancy and confirmation. Native check templates and direct numeric entry are considered; a short actual-value record has no established narrative or repeated-copying burden that dictation would remove.

Existing clock synchronisation and arithmetic are already automated or near-zero within verification, so neither earns labour savings. A new display does not remove actual reading or the engineer conversation. No automatic clock adjustment, departure clearance or message is introduced.

s4 confirms the completed record before s5 save; edits invalidate approval. Same-system save is approximately zero time and carries no saving. Provisional B=100, R=100, gross=0; incremental=0; net=0. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Actual verification and record-entry practice with current instruments.
research_questions: Observe the instrument check, engineer confirmation and actual record entry separately before proposing any change.

incremental.description: No new workflow or upkeep introduced

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No supported reduction after separating reference lookup, actual instrument readings, engineer discussion, record capture and save.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
